profile.headline: Talented and Dedicated Software Engineer
profile.summary:
SUMMARY OF QUALIFICATIONS
◾ Adept at designing, developing, maintaining, and supporting software products ranging from small single-developer
efforts to large applications with hundreds of developers and tens of millions of lines of code.
◾ Proven adaptability, having excelled in such diverse domains as aerospace, workforce management, computer aided
design, and consumer/retail order, fulfillment, and distribution.
◾ Outstanding technical skills, with proven ability to quickly learn new concepts, technologies, and domains.
◾ Excellent communication skills and track record interfacing with users/customers, management, and peers.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
◾ Languages: Python, Java, C++ / C, SQL, JavaScript / React, HTML, XML
◾ Technologies: OOAD, Design Patterns, Java EE, WildFly / JBoss, REST, Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server, JAXB,
Apache POI, Hazelcast data grid, Drools BRMS, Savvion BPM, Rhapsody API, Swing
◾ Operating Systems: Windows, macOS, Linux, AIX, HP-UX, Solaris, VxWorks, Android
◾ Development Tools: Eclipse, NetBeans, Visual Studio, SQL Developer, GNU Toolchain (GCC, G++, GDB), pytest, JUnit, CppUnit, CheckStyle, Purify, Insure++, Jenkins, Atlassian Jira and Bamboo, Git, Perforce / Swarm, Subversio

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Contracted to Lockheed Martin Space for software engineering on NASA's Orion spacecraft program.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contracted to Lockheed Martin Space and United Launch Alliance for software engineering on NASA's Orion spacecraft and Space Launch System (SLS) rocket programs.

◾ Upper Stage Flight Software Test Environment – simulation and avionics emulation for flight software testing
▪️Created design and implemented minimum viable product, then led further production development of Python application that has become the company’s tool of choice for flight software test automation, reducing testing time and opportunity for human error by leveraging Jira test plans and Bamboo automation to efficiently distribute tests, postprocess results, and report results in Jira.
▪️Led development of a set of Python tools and REST API services used to automate coordination of multiple simulations for integrated testing of all flight software for the full Artemis vehicle “stack” in company and program partner testing labs. Trained user groups, integrated software into testing labs, and provided operations support.
▪️Implemented avionics emulation functionality and tests in C++ and Python for modeling and detection of Orion crew capsule separation from the upper stage during nominal flight operations and off-nominal launch aborts.
▪️ Performed additional team roles as technical lead and scrum master.
▪️See PDF resume in profile for more details.

◾ Orion Crew Capsule Flight Software Data Services – client-server application for flight software data management
▪️Developed various capabilities for multi-tiered system using HTML/JavaScript/React for web client presentation tier, Java EE/WildFly for REST web services and application server logic tier, and Oracle/ SQL for data tier.
▪️See PDF resume in profile for more details.

◾Orion Crew Capsule Flight Software Data Tools – software for insertion/extraction of data to/from flight software
▪️Developed tools and APIs in Java and C++ used on demand or automatically during flight software builds.
▪️See PDF resume in profile for more details.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Performed software development of workforce modeling/scheduling automation software service.

◾Developed Java EE/JBoss hosted RESTful web service APIs, CRUD services, and complex business logic for next generation multi-tiered application, re-architected and rewritten for improved usability, scalability, and maintainability.
◾Designed and implemented automated customer data synchronization service and worked directly with customer IT personnel to tune flexible configuration to handle their data/format.
◾Implemented Java and Drools Business Rules Management System (BRMS) code for working prototype functionality that used past business activity data to forecast skill “demand curves” for use in generating optimized staffing schedules.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · Eclipse · Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) · Java · JPA · Representational State Transfer (REST) · MySQL · Drools · Jira · Scrum · Git

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Performed software engineering for space flight operations at NASA's Johnson Space Center.

◾ Core Trajectory System – client-server trajectory data project for what would eventually become the Artemis program
▪️ Collaborated with architect and led development of security subsystem governing authentication, authorization, and data encryption for JBoss-hosted EJBand Swing client applications.
▪️ Prototyped a workflow subsystem leveraging the Savvion Business Process Management (BPM) system to build and host the web and BPM logic tiers, layered atop a JBoss web service tier and MySQL data tier.
▪️ Developed and taught an Object-Oriented Analysis and Design (OOAD) class on Inheritance and Polymorphism for team members new to Java.
▪️ See PDF resume in profile for more details.

◾ Manual Procedure Viewer – custom electronic procedure system for Mission Control and International Space Station
▪️ Implemented new features and bug fixes requested by astronauts and flight controllers in multi-platform C++ code base developed for variants running on Windows and UNIX variant laptops and workstations.
▪️ See PDF resume in profile for more details.

◾ Cockpit Avionics Upgrade – project to upgrade the Space Shuttle to modern “smart cockpit” avionics
▪️ Led C++ software development of a lab-embedded real time Space Shuttle flight computer memory capture system for use in avionics laboratories during system verification and certification.
▪️ See PDF resume in profile for more details.

◾ Spacecraft Trajectory Analysis and Mission Planning Simulation –flight design Space Shuttle trajectory simulator
▪️ Implemented bug fixes in C code for a flight simulation tool used by Space Shuttle flight controllers and flight design personnel in mission design, support, and analysis.
▪️ See PDF resume in profile for more details.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · Java · Java Swing · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Quality Engineer
positions.description:
Performed software debugging and testing of Computer Aided Design (CAD) software product.

◾Performed testing, debugging, and fixing C/C++ code in company’s Computer Aided Design (CAD) software product.
◾Enhanced existing automated distributed testing tool with new features to generate and report test output diffs between various UNIX and Windows platforms, greatly reducing time required reviewing nightly test execution results.

positions.title: Computer Systems Operator
positions.description:
Performed computer system operations and user technical support.

◾Came aboard as a cooperative education student then remained full time while completing degree.
◾Performed system backups and executed daily batch and interactive data processing tasks.
◾Provided technical support to users in the call center and distribution center.
